orders.title: Inspection orders
orders.description: Four source kinds (final-operation reporting / outsourcing return auto-create + manual); release feeds stock-in.
orders.empty: No inspection orders under the current filter

summary.title: Inspection summary
summary.description: Pending / pass rate / not closed (inspection.summary, same source as the workbench KPI).

detail.title: Inspection order details and judgment
detail.description: Judgment (passed/failed quantities); failed results auto-create disposal orders; recheck can re-judge.

concession.kind-not-allowed: Current inspection order is {{kind}}; concession not applicable (concession applies only to the failed quantity of non-standard purchase inspection orders)

revoke.no-permission: The current account lacks permission to revoke judgments; the operation is disabled. Contact an administrator to grant the permission, then refresh the page to use it.
revoke.pending-state: This inspection order has not been judged yet; there is no judgment to revoke.
revoke.closed-state: This inspection order is closed (terminal state); the judgment cannot be revoked.
revoke.effect: After revocation: the judgment returns to pending; passed/failed quantities and judge fields are cleared; nonconformity lines are voided (disposed ones kept); the conceded quantity is reset to zero.
revoke.not-supported: The current state does not support judgment revocation.
revoke.confirm-text: Revoke this order's judgment? The order returns to pending and the previous judgment fields are cleared; the nonconformity lines of the failed judgment are voided with it (disposed ones unaffected); the conceded quantity is reset to zero and the linked release is withdrawn.
revoke.retry-hint: Refresh the list to verify this order's current state and version before retrying; do not resubmit blindly.

create.title: Create inspection order manually
create.description: Source type and source object must be paired (report/dispatch/receipt; default = manual creation). Work-order linkage is established indirectly via the source object (work report / outsourcing / receipt); direct attachment to a work order is not yet available.
create.source-ref-label: Source object id (paired with source type)

nonconformities.title: Nonconformity disposal
nonconformities.empty: No nonconformity disposal orders under the current filter

disposal-card.title: Disposal order details and actions
disposal-card.description: Dispose (rework / concession / scrap + required reason) → close.
